title: Views
description: The per-frame closure, `Context`, inline state queries, and how a view is rebuilt whenever input or animation asks for a frame.
descriptionZh: 每帧闭包、`Context`、内联状态查询，以及输入或动画请求新帧时视图如何重建。

title: Layout
description: Rows and columns, fixed and filled sizes, padding, margins, gaps, alignment and justification, solved on the CPU.
descriptionZh: 行与列、固定与填充尺寸、内边距、外边距、间距、对齐与两端对齐，全部在 CPU 上求解。

title: Text
description: Text with font size, weight, color, wrap width and alignment, measured and wrapped without shaping or kerning.
descriptionZh: 带字号、字重、颜色、换行宽度与对齐的文本，测量与换行，不做字形整形或字距调整。

title: Styling and themes
description: Colors, spacing and type tokens from `Theme`, light/dark detection, and raw drawing commands for backgrounds, borders and gradients.
descriptionZh: `Theme` 提供的颜色、间距与字号令牌，明暗检测，以及背景、边框与渐变的原始绘制命令。

title: Input
description: The pointer, hover and press, Tab focus traversal, keyboard activation, single-line text entry, and wheel scrolling.
descriptionZh: 指针、悬停与按压、Tab 焦点遍历、键盘激活、单行文本输入，以及滚轮滚动。

title: Drag and drop
description: Values dragged within the window, and rows reordered by dragging. Native UI does not take drops; file drops reach WebView windows only.
descriptionZh: 窗口内拖动的值，以及拖动重排的行。原生界面不接收投放；文件投放只进入 WebView 窗口。

title: Pages and navigation
description: A router of pages with a history, layouts, transitions, and going back and forward.
descriptionZh: 带历史、布局、过渡与前进后退的页面路由。

title: Overlays
description: What dialogs, popovers and the layer above the window share: the focus, Escape, and what is behind them.
descriptionZh: 对话框、弹出框与窗口之上那层共有的东西：焦点、Escape，以及它们背后的内容。

title: Accessibility
description: Semantic nodes are emitted for labels, buttons, fields, choices, sliders, scroll views and groups; no AT-SPI, UIA or NSAccessibility bridge is connected yet.
descriptionZh: 为标签、按钮、输入框、选项、滑块、滚动视图与分组发出语义节点；尚未连接 AT-SPI、UIA 或 NSAccessibility 桥。

title: Right to left
description: Interfaces laid out from the right for Arabic and Hebrew, logical edges, and what mirrors.
descriptionZh: 为阿拉伯语与希伯来语从右布局的界面、逻辑边，以及镜像的内容。

title: Languages
description: The window's language and regional formats, numbers and dates written in them, and the controls' own strings.
descriptionZh: 窗口语言与地区格式、按其书写的数字与日期，以及控件自身的文案。

title: Drawing and animation
description: Raw `DisplayList` commands, and `Animation` and `Easing` values driven from the frame clock.
descriptionZh: 原始 `DisplayList` 命令，以及由帧时钟驱动的 `Animation` 与 `Easing` 值。

title: Shaders
description: Pixels computed on the GPU by shaders.
descriptionZh: 由着色器在 GPU 上计算的像素。

title: Transitions
description: Elements that move, resize, recolor and shade smoothly as the layout changes.
descriptionZh: 随布局变化平滑移动、缩放、变色与渐隐的元素。

title: Motion
description: Easing and per-frame `animate` values are built in; springs, keyframes and timelines are not.
descriptionZh: 内置缓动与逐帧 `animate` 值；不含弹簧、关键帧与时间线。

title: Transforms
description: Display-list transform and scissor commands rasterize, and pointer hit-testing inverse-transforms the pointer into local bounds.
descriptionZh: 显示列表的变换与裁剪命令可以光栅化，指针命中测试会把指针逆变换回局部坐标。

title: Custom widgets
description: Containers plus drawing commands can compose custom visuals; there is no widget-base protocol to reuse behavior.
descriptionZh: 容器加绘制命令可以组合出自定义视觉；没有可复用行为的控件基类协议。

title: Windows with native UI
description: `WindowContent::NativeUi`, window options, window-state persistence, and the CPU presenter that paints each frame.
descriptionZh: `WindowContent::NativeUi`、窗口选项、窗口状态持久化，以及逐帧绘制的 CPU 呈现器。

title: Testing
description: `NativeUi::render(size)` runs a view without a window and returns the display list, frame timing and accessibility nodes.
descriptionZh: `NativeUi::render(size)` 在没有窗口的情况下运行视图，返回显示列表、帧耗时与无障碍节点。

title: Inspector
description: The elements of a window, their boxes and styles, and the time frames take, beside the content.
descriptionZh: 窗口的元素、它们的盒子与样式，以及每帧耗时，显示在内容旁边。

title: Rendering
description: Layout on the CPU, a rasterizer for geometry and text, `softbuffer` presentation, and an optional wgpu offscreen renderer.
descriptionZh: 在 CPU 上布局，几何与文本光栅化器，`softbuffer` 呈现，以及可选的 wgpu 离屏渲染器。

title: Browsers
description: The same app in a page, compiled to WebAssembly and drawn with WebGL.
descriptionZh: 同一个应用放进网页，编译为 WebAssembly 并用 WebGL 绘制。

title: Migration
description: Element values, persistent handles, focus bindings and source migration.
descriptionZh: 元素值、持久句柄、焦点绑定与源码迁移。

title: Performance
description: Measured frame costs and retained memory.
descriptionZh: 测量的帧开销与保留内存。

title: Button
description: A push button with hover, press and keyboard activation; fill, border and label use the theme.
descriptionZh: 带悬停、按压与键盘激活的按钮；填充、边框与标签取自主题。

title: Link
description: Text that opens a URL, or a page of a router.
descriptionZh: 打开 URL 或路由器页面的文本。

title: Menu button
description: A button opening a menu below it, the system's or one drawn in the window with the theme's look.
descriptionZh: 在其下方打开菜单的按钮，系统的菜单或用主题外观在窗口内绘制的菜单。

title: Context menu
description: A menu of the system's for any element, on a right click. Application-level context menus exist outside the view.
descriptionZh: 右键时为任意元素显示的系统菜单。应用级上下文菜单存在于视图之外。

title: Toggle
description: A button that stays pressed, and toggles joined in a group.
descriptionZh: 保持按下状态的按钮，以及成组联动的开关。

title: Segmented control
description: Segments choosing one of a few views.
descriptionZh: 在一组视图中选择一个的分段。

title: Toolbar
description: A row of controls along a window, which overflow into a menu.
descriptionZh: 沿窗口排列的一行控件，溢出时收入菜单。

title: Checkbox
description: A check box with hover, focus and click or keyboard toggling, drawn from the theme.
descriptionZh: 带悬停、焦点与点击或键盘切换的复选框，外观取自主题。

title: Switch
description: A switch that turns a setting on and off.
descriptionZh: 开启和关闭设置的开关。

title: Radio
description: Radio buttons choosing one value, in a group.
descriptionZh: 成组选择单个值的单选按钮。

title: Select
description: A drop-down choosing one of a list.
descriptionZh: 从列表中选择一项的下拉框。

title: Slider
description: A horizontal slider setting a value in a range, with hover, drag and keyboard focus.
descriptionZh: 在范围内设定值的水平滑块，带悬停、拖动与键盘焦点。

title: Range slider
description: Two knobs setting a low and a high value.
descriptionZh: 用两个手柄设定下限与上限。

title: Stepper
description: Arrows stepping a value up and down.
descriptionZh: 用箭头上下调整数值。

title: Rating
description: Stars setting a rating.
descriptionZh: 用星标打分。

title: Text input
description: A single-line field with character input, Backspace, Delete, Home/End and cursor movement; clipboard, undo and IME are not implemented.
descriptionZh: 单行输入框，支持字符输入、Backspace、Delete、Home/End 与光标移动；未实现剪贴板、撤销与 IME。

title: Text-input primitives
description: Application-owned text, native composition and queries, and retained geometry for custom controls.
descriptionZh: 应用自持文本、原生输入法组合与查询，以及自定义控件可复用的保留几何。

title: Number input
description: A number in a range, typed or stepped.
descriptionZh: 范围内的数字，可键入或步进。

title: Decimal input
description: An exact decimal, as an amount of money, typed or stepped, never rounded.
descriptionZh: 精确小数（如金额），可键入或步进，永不四舍五入。

title: Search field
description: A field for searching, which Escape clears.
descriptionZh: 用于搜索的输入框，Escape 清空。

title: Combobox
description: A field choosing one of a list, which typing filters.
descriptionZh: 从列表选择一项的输入框，键入即过滤。

title: Autocomplete
description: A text input suggesting what was typed.
descriptionZh: 对已输入内容提供建议的文本框。

title: Token field
description: A list of strings as chips, as tags or recipients.
descriptionZh: 以 chip 呈现的字符串列表，如标签或收件人。

title: Editable text
description: A text renamed in place, as a file's name in Finder.
descriptionZh: 就地重命名的文本，如 Finder 中的文件名。

title: Find bar
description: A bar for finding text, with the count of matches and the next and previous ones.
descriptionZh: 查找文本的栏，显示匹配数并提供上一个/下一个。

title: Rich text editor
description: Attributed text with formats, links, headings, lists, tasks and images.
descriptionZh: 带格式、链接、标题、列表、任务与图片的属性文本。

title: Code editor
description: An editor of code with highlighting, several carets, folding, completions and diagnostics.
descriptionZh: 带高亮、多光标、折叠、补全与诊断的代码编辑器。

title: Diff viewer
description: The changes between two texts, side by side or unified, with the new text editable.
descriptionZh: 两段文本之间的更改，并排或统一显示，新文本可编辑。

title: Markdown
description: CommonMark and GitHub's Markdown, as finished documents, selectable and copied as text.
descriptionZh: CommonMark 与 GitHub Markdown，作为完成的文档显示，可选中并以文本复制。

title: Calendar
description: A month choosing a day.
descriptionZh: 选择日期的月份视图。

title: Date input
description: A date in a field, chosen in a calendar below it.
descriptionZh: 输入框中的日期，在下方日历中选择。

title: Time input
description: The time of day, its hours and minutes typed or stepped.
descriptionZh: 一天中的时间，时与分可键入或步进。

title: Color picker
description: A color well, and the picker it opens.
descriptionZh: 色块及其打开的取色面板。

title: List
description: Rows of any number and height, built only while in view.
descriptionZh: 任意数量与高度的行，仅在可见时构建。

title: Table
description: Rows in columns that the user sorts, resizes and moves.
descriptionZh: 列中的行，用户可排序、调整大小与移动。

title: Tree
description: Items that open and close, built inside the items they belong to.
descriptionZh: 可展开与收起的项目，在其所属项目内构建。

title: Outline
description: A tree of any size, as a list or a table.
descriptionZh: 任意规模的树，以列表或表格呈现。

title: Grid view
description: Items in a grid of any size, as a photo library.
descriptionZh: 任意规模的项目网格，如图片库。

title: Scroll view
description: A clipped, vertically scrollable container with wheel, drag-bar and keyboard input.
descriptionZh: 裁剪的垂直可滚动容器，支持滚轮、拖条与键盘输入。

title: Grid
description: Children in equal-width columns and rows. A public `grid` builder places them.
descriptionZh: 等宽列与行中的子元素。公开的 `grid` 构建器可放置它们。

title: Split view
description: Two panes with a divider the user drags.
descriptionZh: 两个面板，中间的分隔条可拖动。

title: Collapsible
description: Content that a label shows and hides.
descriptionZh: 由标签显示与隐藏的内容。

title: Accordion
description: Sections that open and close, one above the other.
descriptionZh: 上下排列、可展开与收起的区块。

title: Form
description: Labeled controls with descriptions and errors.
descriptionZh: 带描述与错误提示的标签控件。

title: Web view
description: A web page in the window, under the native UI painted after it.
descriptionZh: 窗口中的网页，位于其上层绘制的原生界面之下。

title: Tabs
description: A row of tabs choosing a page.
descriptionZh: 选择页面的一行标签。

title: Sidebar
description: A source list of items in sections.
descriptionZh: 按分区组织项目的源列表。

title: Breadcrumbs
description: A path whose items take the user back.
descriptionZh: 项目可带你返回的路径。

title: Back and forward buttons
description: Buttons going through a router's history.
descriptionZh: 在路由器历史中前进与后退的按钮。

title: Dialog
description: A dialog over the dimmed window.
descriptionZh: 浮在变暗窗口之上的对话框。

title: Alert dialog
description: A question about something important, with buttons.
descriptionZh: 关于重要事项的提问，带按钮。

title: Popover
description: A panel below an element.
descriptionZh: 元素下方的面板。

title: Tooltip
description: A tip shown as the pointer rests on an element, or the keyboard focus comes to it.
descriptionZh: 指针停留或键盘焦点到达元素时显示的提示。

title: Toast
description: A short message near the bottom of the window, with an action or not.
descriptionZh: 窗口底部附近的短消息，可带操作。

title: Progress bar
description: Work done so far, or of unknown length.
descriptionZh: 已完成的工作，或长度未知的进度。

title: Spinner
description: Spokes turning while work of unknown length goes on. The loading example draws one by hand.
descriptionZh: 长度未知的工作进行时旋转的辐条。loading 示例手工绘制了一个。

title: Meter
description: A value in a range, colored by its level.
descriptionZh: 范围内的值，按级别着色。

title: Badge
description: A short text in a pill, as a count.
descriptionZh: 胶囊中的短文本，如计数。

title: Charts
description: Scales, axes and marks without a look, for bars, lines, areas, stacks and donuts. The streaming example draws lines by hand.
descriptionZh: 无外观的刻度、坐标轴与标记，用于柱状、折线、面积、堆叠与环形。streaming 示例手工绘制折线。

title: Image
description: Bitmaps and SVGs in their own colors.
descriptionZh: 以自身颜色显示的位图与 SVG。

title: Video
description: Video files and streams with sound, played by the system's media engine.
descriptionZh: 带声音的视频文件与流，由系统媒体引擎播放。

title: Icon
description: Built-in SVG path data, flattened and rasterized by the CPU presenter.
descriptionZh: crate 内置 SVG 路径数据，由 CPU 呈现器展平并光栅化。

title: Avatar
description: A picture of a person, or their initials.
descriptionZh: 人物图片或其姓名首字母。
